turns.user_utterance: My card got rejected when I tried to tap it at the checkout!
turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—was this rejection specifically when you tried to use contactless (tap) at the checkout, or did it also fail if you insert/swipe the card?

turns.user_utterance: Only when I tried to tap—swipe or insert works fine.
turns.assistant_response: Got it—if swipe/insert works but contactless tap is being rejected, it’s likely a contactless issue. A few quick checks: can you confirm the card is within the contactless limit for the tap (e.g., below the amount that triggers PIN), and that you’re tapping directly on the reader for about 1 second? If it’s still rejected, tell me whether this happens everywhere or just at one merchant, and whether it’s a new card or you’ve recently changed anything on the account.
